name: Xiaomi Smart Band 10 Pro
about: The device definition both calibration kits generate from (tools/vela-calib, tools/face-calib). Measured facts live in profile.json, not here.

screen.source: maker's spec; size, 1:1 designWidth and corner radius (46-48.5 px) confirmed by Vela Calib 1.0.0 photos, 2026-09-27

face.note: band10-toolkit only targets 212 x 520 (DeviceType 466); pack.mts packs 336 x 480 with the same native packer. Verified 2026-09-29: the Band 10 Pro (fw 3.101.043) accepted all 8 face-calib build 1 faces and they were photographed and measured (profile.json face section). Community DeviceType for this band (567) is inferred, not checked; the packer doesn't write one.

firmware.note: the firmware the kits were last run on; profile.json firmware.version is authoritative for its facts

quickapp.note: text_slack measured: this band's glyph widths were measured, so Text V/W slots use small slack. The word list adds sample strings from a transit-times app (station names, status words).

face.note: frame pinned: face-calib build 1 was photographed with it (2026-09-29)
